name: AIZPTToken
fix_description: The ETH payout formula uses the full sell_amount in the denominator (_balances[address(this)] + sell_amount), but only 50% of sell_amount (swap_amount) actually enters the contract reserves — the other 50% is burned. Fix by using swap_amount instead of sell_amount in the price calculation: ethAmount = (swap_amount * address(this).balance) / (_balances[address(this)] + swap_amount).
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is very short and direct: take a flash loan, send BNB to the vulnerable token contract, repeatedly transfer tokens back to the token contract to abuse its flawed accounting/logic, then repay and keep profit. It involves only a couple of contracts and no deep DeFi mechanics beyond a basic flash loan wrapper, so a competent auditor could likely build this PoC quickly.
